title: Tenant Groups Semantic Contract
description: Source-backed draft semantic contract for the tenant groups capability, derived from historical React evidence as lineage. Facets cite verified source-import manifest rows; proof is hermetic/runtime lineage and not fresh USF proof.
aiGuidance: Source-backed draft. Facets cite verified manifest source rows as lineage; proof is hermetic/stale and not current readiness. Do not treat as implementation authority or fresh proof; respect the hexagonal constraint in ADR 0005.

lifecycle.description: List, create, update, and delete tenant groups with name validation, duplicate checks, and protected-name guards.

stateModel.description: Groups are realm-scoped (id, name, path) in the tenant identity provider; reserved names are protected; not persisted in the relational store.

permissions.description: tenant.groups.read/create/update/delete, tenant-scoped, mapped to organisation:groups authorization scopes.

contracts.description: Org-scoped group list/create and per-group update/delete operations.

validation.description: Name must be a non-empty string within length, free of separators/control characters, not reserved, and not a case-insensitive duplicate.

errorModel.description: invalid_name, conflict, not_found, and protected outcomes; missing credential degrades explicitly.

auditModel.description: Group create/update/delete are audited after validation and before the identity-provider mutation.

readinessModel.description: Requires tenant context and an auth-settings credential; identity-provider unavailability is an explicit degradation.

proof.description: Unit proof of group validation, conflicts, and protected names. Demonstrated in React via hermetic/runtime proof lineage; fresh USF proof pending USF-101/USF-59.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: No verified UI source path in the manifest yet; the React headless group journey is lineage only. Author the UI semantic model before generation.
